problem:
Let $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}}$ be a basis of ${R}^{3}$ and let $S$ be the standard basis of ${R}^{3}.$ What are the values of $a,b,$ and $c$ if 

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 4 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],
$$

and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $B$ to $S$ is 

$$
{P}_{B\to S}=[\begin{aligned}a & -5 & 0 \\ 4 & b & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & c\end{aligned}].
$$
